text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 287 Lauder Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the tree clearance cannot be met. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the request for front yard parking at 287 Lauder Avenue, with the following conditions: 1. The parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.4 metres and be 5.3 metres in length. 2. The applicant remove the existing asphalt and repave the parking area with semi-permeable paving materials, as indicated in Attachment 'A', attached to the report dated December 13, 2017, from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services. 3. The applicant shall remove the asphalt ramp fronting the parking pad. 4. The applicant contact Urban Forestry in order to comply with any and all requirements in accordance with the City of Toronto Tree Protection Policy and Specification for Construction Near Trees as construction is proposed near or within the tree protection zone. 5.
